name: Lilia Milcrabe
original_name: リリア・ミルクレーブ
source:
Lilia works for the local police department's special investigation unit headed by Fauthen. Raika is a close friend who shares a lot of the same duties in their respective jobs. In F40, she is tasked with finding three missing persons. When her search leads nowhere, she turns to Raika for help. Raika, with no case to work on at the moment agrees to help.

Compromising situations easily embarrass Lilia. She's been trying to keep her relationship to Mark a secret and does so successfully until Raika bumps into them while they are on a date. She's ashamed to introduce her boyfriend to Raika, although both she and Seela agree they make a cute couple.

Although she works for Seela's father, Lilia had never met Seela before Raika introduced them to each other.

She is an Aquarius (January 20 - February 18).
